examples.en: Leader completeness follows from the voting restriction.
examples.zh: 领导者完整性来自投票环节的限制规则。

situation.en: Raft's leader completeness property is why committed entries are never lost.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 领导者完整性（新领导者必有全部已提交日志）

examples.en: State machine replication turns consensus into a replicated service.
examples.zh: 状态机复制把共识变成了一个可复制的服务。

situation.en: Under the hood it is state machine replication: same log, same transitions.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 状态机复制（副本执行同一命令序列）

examples.en: A replicated state machine stays consistent by replaying the shared log.
examples.zh: 复制状态机通过重放共享日志保持一致。

situation.en: We model the metadata store as a replicated state machine over Raft.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 复制状态机（共识之上的服务形态）

examples.en: Byzantine fault tolerance assumes nodes may lie, not just crash.
examples.zh: 拜占庭容错假设节点不只是会崩，还会说谎。

situation.en: Inside one company, Byzantine fault tolerance is usually unnecessary cost.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 拜占庭容错（容忍作恶节点）

examples.en: Crash fault tolerance covers the failures we actually see in production.
examples.zh: 崩溃容错覆盖了我们在生产环境真正遇到的故障。

situation.en: Raft gives us crash fault tolerance, which is all a single-operator cluster needs.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 崩溃容错（只容忍停机式故障）

examples.en: The FLP impossibility result is why timeouts exist in practice.
examples.zh: FLP 不可能定理正是实践中必须用超时的原因。

situation.en: We sidestep the FLP impossibility with failure detectors and partial synchrony.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: FLP 不可能定理（异步网络无确定性共识）

examples.en: The PACELC theorem extends CAP to normal operation.
examples.zh: PACELC 定理把 CAP 扩展到了正常运行时的权衡。

situation.en: PACELC theorem in one line: if no partition, still choose between latency and consistency.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: PACELC 定理（分区之外还要权衡延迟）

examples.en: Every failure detector is wrong sometimes; design for that.
examples.zh: 每个故障检测器有时都会判断错；设计要预料到这一点。

situation.en: Our failure detector marks nodes suspect first and dead only after confirmation.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 故障检测器（判断节点死活的机制）

examples.en: A suspicious failure triggers investigation, not failover.
examples.zh: 可疑故障触发的是排查，而不是故障切换。

situation.en: Treat a suspicious failure as a hint: check before you promote anything.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 可疑故障（尚未确认的疑似失效）

examples.en: The membership protocol spreads joins and leaves through gossip.
examples.zh: 成员协议通过流言传播节点的加入和离开。

situation.en: Our membership protocol converges in a few gossip rounds.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 成员协议（维护集群名单的机制）

examples.en: The SWIM protocol keeps failure detection cheap at thousands of nodes.
examples.zh: SWIM 协议让上千节点下的故障检测依然便宜。

situation.en: We picked the SWIM protocol because heartbeats to everyone do not scale.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: SWIM 协议（可扩展的成员与故障检测）

examples.en: A gossip protocol spreads state the way rumors spread.
examples.zh: 流言协议传播状态的方式，就像谣言扩散一样。

situation.en: Cluster state travels by gossip protocol; convergence takes seconds, not minutes.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 流言协议（像传闲话一样扩散信息）

examples.en: Delta synchronization ships only what changed since the last sync.
examples.zh: 增量同步只传上次同步以来变化的部分。

situation.en: For the mobile client, delta synchronization beats full downloads on every metric.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 增量同步（只传变化的部分）

examples.en: Anti-entropy sessions compare replicas and repair the drift.
examples.zh: 反熵会话会比对副本并修复漂移。

situation.en: Hints cover short outages; anti-entropy cleans up everything else.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 反熵（副本间定期对账修复）

examples.en: A Merkle tree localizes replica differences in a few comparisons.
examples.zh: 默克尔树用少量比对就能定位副本间的差异。

situation.en: Replicas exchange a Merkle tree root first, then drill into mismatched branches.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 默克尔树（快速比对副本差异的哈希树）

examples.en: Read repair fixes a stale replica when a read notices it.
examples.zh: 读修复会在读发现副本过旧时顺手把它修好。

situation.en: Read repair is lazy but free; anti-entropy is the safety net behind it.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 读修复（读的时候顺手修旧副本）

examples.en: During hinted handoff, a healthy node holds writes for a down peer.
examples.zh: 在提示转交中，健康节点会替宕机的同伴暂存写入。

situation.en: Hinted handoff keeps writes flowing while one node reboots.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 提示转交（代存数据等目标恢复再转交）

examples.en: A delete writes a tombstone instead of removing the row.
examples.zh: 删除会写下一个墓碑标记，而不是直接删掉那行。

situation.en: Every delete becomes a tombstone so replicas cannot resurrect old data.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 墓碑标记（删除先打记号而非真删）

examples.en: Three-phase commit reduces blocking but still breaks under partitions.
examples.zh: 三阶段提交减少了阻塞，但在分区下依然会出问题。

situation.en: Three-phase commit sounds safer, yet real systems prefer Paxos-style consensus.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 三阶段提交（多一个准备阶段的原子提交）

examples.en: The saga pattern replaces one big transaction with compensating steps.
examples.zh: Saga 模式用带补偿的步骤序列替代一个大事务。

situation.en: Cross-service flows use the saga pattern; each step knows how to undo itself.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: Saga 模式（长事务拆成本地事务加补偿）

examples.en: Exactly-once semantics usually mean at-least-once plus deduplication.
examples.zh: 精确一次语义通常意味着至少一次投递加去重。

situation.en: We claim exactly-once semantics only inside the pipeline, never end to end.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 精确一次语义（不重不丢的处理保证）

examples.en: Metrics use at-most-once delivery; a lost sample is acceptable.
examples.zh: 指标用的是至多一次投递：丢一个样本可以接受。

situation.en: At-most-once delivery fits telemetry; orders need the opposite choice.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 至多一次投递（可能丢、绝不重）

examples.en: An XA transaction coordinates the database and the message broker.
examples.zh: XA 事务协调数据库和消息中间件。

situation.en: We retired the last XA transaction; operational pain outweighed the elegance.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: XA 事务（跨资源的标准两阶段协议）

examples.en: A version vector summarizes who has seen what, per replica.
examples.zh: 版本向量概括了每个副本都见过什么。

situation.en: Conflicts surface when neither version vector dominates the other.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 版本向量（每副本一份的因果指纹）

examples.en: A CRDT merges concurrent edits without a coordinator.
examples.zh: CRDT 能在没有协调者的情况下合并并发编辑。

situation.en: For collaborative counters and sets, a CRDT removes the ordering problem entirely.
situation.zh: 面试官追问分布式细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 无冲突复制数据类型（天然可合并的数据结构）

examples.en: Strong eventual consistency promises convergence without waiting.
examples.zh: 强最终一致性承诺无需等待即可收敛。

situation.en: CRDTs deliver strong eventual consistency: same updates in, same state out.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 强最终一致性（同更新集必同状态）

examples.en: Each physical node owns many virtual nodes on the ring.
examples.zh: 每个物理节点在环上拥有许多虚拟节点。

situation.en: Adding virtual nodes evens out the key distribution.
situation.zh: 设计评审上有人问一致性怎么保证，你回答：

entries.zh: 虚拟节点（一致性哈希里的分片影子）

examples.en: Keys map to positions on the token ring.
examples.zh: 键被映射到令牌环上的位置。

situation.en: The token ring layout decides which replica set serves each range.
situation.zh: 你在设计文档里这样写权衡：

entries.zh: 令牌环（一致性哈希的环结构）
